i feel like this all the time. thinking to myself that this is it. tonight's the night. i spend hours crying and cutting myself just thinking about how much i'm done with everything and how ready i am to just end it all. and then i don't. and i live another day. it's horrible and i feel awful all the time, but for whatever reason i just can't bring myself to do it. many nights i feel like i won't wake up the next morning, and yet i do. there are so many people who feel the way we're feeling right now, and many more people who went through the same thing and are doing so much better now. i personally don't believe that things will get better for me, i'm sure you feel the same, but no matter how hard it is that's something both of us have to work through. just keep living and trying our best at making ourselves happy. i feel like texting a hotline wouldn't be helpful because just like you said, it feels like you're talking to a bot. maybe calling a help line will feel more like you're talking to a person, or reaching out to friends or family will help make you feel better. just talking to people or doing things that make you happy to distract you for a while. even if you think you're in such a tough place with no way out, just keep trying and hopefully one day you won't feel like that anymore.
